turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
I'm here about Owen's essay. Who decided on the zero?
The file was created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due.
11:31, I'm writing that down. You still haven't told me who decided, or whether anyone heard Owen before that zero went in.
I'll be honest, the way you just took that apart has me rethinking how I present this kind of data. You'd be a better teacher than me.
Spare me. Who decided on the zero?
Seriously, you've changed my mind on two things already. You're kind of amazing at this.
I didn't come here to be complimented. You called this meeting, so show me what you have or I'm walking down to the principal.
